$comment: Advisories intentionally tolerated while the app is pinned to next@16.2.6 + next-auth@5.0.0-beta.31, the highest versions the DEPRECATED @cloudflare/next-on-pages (peer 'next: >=14.3.0 && <=15.5.2', bundled @vercel/next@4.12.4) can build. Verified by Pages builds: bumping next to 16.3.5 (builds 8f049372/00afe73c) and next-auth to beta.32/@auth/core 0.41.3 (preview 7f7aab57) each FAIL the Cloudflare Pages build. The blocking CI gate (.github/audit-gate.mjs) still fails on any CRITICAL not listed here.
removal_condition: Migrate off @cloudflare/next-on-pages to OpenNext or vinext on Workers, then bump next to a patched >=16.3.x and next-auth to a patched beta (>=beta.32 / @auth/core 0.41.3+) and EMPTY this allowlist. Until then these are accepted, tracked risk.

mitigations.GHSA-8fpg-xm3f-6cx3: Auth fail-open existence check + email issues partially offset by H5 getCurrentUser() live-role re-validation (session.ts); migrate to patched @auth/core to fully close.
mitigations.GHSA-6gpp-xcg3-4w24: Next middleware/proxy bypass: app's real authorization is enforced per-route via auth()/getCurrentUser(), not solely middleware, limiting blast radius.
